basis: Previously reviewed the page-2 FIA Competition Notes - Pirelli Preview screenshot and matched it to the exact PDF SHA-256 below. The sheet specifies 29.0/>=30.0 psi front and 27.5/>=28.5 psi rear slick pressures, -2.75/-1.50 degree camber limits, mandatory C1/C2 race tyres, C3 for Q3, and a 27-lap maximum across tyre history. Updated Qatar Tyres/Notes copy to attribute these prescriptions to the FIA source. Pirelli's 24 November infographic independently matches the pressures and adds a 26.5-second average pit-stop loss. The FIA sheet does not resolve Formula1.com's conflicting per-driver set totals (2/3/8 plus a Q3 Soft versus 2/4/7); these remain explicitly conflicting, not transcribed as an allocation. Existing Power Unit Information review and its separate energy/Overtake interpretation remain unchanged. On 26 November, visually reviewed the hash-matched FIA Car Display Procedure screenshot: it governs the Friday car presentation window, display-car selection and weather/logistics only, not upgrade submissions; added that distinction to Upgrades, Schedule and Notes while leaving the still-unlisted team submissions pending. Also visually reviewed Qatar Doc 5: it summons Car 11 / Sergio Perez and the Cadillac team representative over alleged late Thursday press-conference attendance, requires a report at 18:30 local on Friday 27 November, and makes no finding or penalty; added it as a note with its own collapsed source reader, separate from the carried-over Las Vegas grid penalty. The current FIA listing had no circuit-map PDF, while Formula1.com's current 2026 Lusail map is collected and live. Correction to the earlier map interpretation: visual review of FIA Lusail Event Document 5 (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_lusail_event_-_circuit_map_-_lusail_2026.pdf; SHA-256 2ecc4a2296e4c15c3b092866264b001ede07b0d28daf596156fe4aec603954c6) shows an F2 logo and Formula 2 DRS labels. It is not the Formula 1 circuit map; the previously stated 55 m / 190 m DRS points are withdrawn as F1 claims. Reviewed the current FIA Formula 1 circuit map PDF (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_qatar_grand_prix_-_competition_notes_-_circuit_map_pit_lane_drawing_emergency_exits_map_and_red_zone.pdf; SHA-256 d4e6898c25a3e5e99643a84d176732fdf405319e1d6fcf4f27758c2fdfffd3d0) and visually reviewed its substantive screenshot pages 2–5. Page 2 identifies the four normal/low-grip Straight Mode activation pairs and separately gives Overtake detection at the exit of T16 and activation 40 m after T16. Cross-checked those Overtake points against the Power Unit Information loops L24/L25 and 5,020 m / 5,078 m values; these are alternate references, not Straight Mode settings. Reviewed all substantive pages 2–7 of the FIA Race Director competition notes (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_qatar_grand_prix_-_race_directors_competition_notes.pdf; SHA-256 61fae3b9f55f26aee0ceb2f7d0996a3ec577f9bd27978842a9a94c6add01a577). Updated Circuit and Notes with the current F1 map, lapping thresholds, Turn 16 lap invalidation rule and the pending post-FP2 qualifying/reconnaissance maximum. The separately rendered F2 map remains labeled as a support-series source and is not used for F1 technical claims. On 27 November, the live FIA Qatar index added Documents 8 and 9 after the 09:30Z collection. Visually read Doc 8 page 2: it lists season-to-date power-unit element counts for all 22 named drivers. Transcribed each count without interpreting red text as a sanction; added the table to Power Unit and a brief Notes reference. Visually read Doc 9 page 1: all 11 teams submitted completed scrutineering declarations before 21:52 on 26 November; represented the filing as administrative status, not a technical inspection result. Recorded each exact PDF SHA-256 in fia_sha256. On 27 November, visually reviewed the rendered FIA Qatar Technical Delegate's Report, Document 10, page 1 (SHA-256 0e2a99f3ec983dfbfe5a66530f5cb2945adf3915f4b909f494cc3bd3cb3b9f10). It records BWT Alpine car-operating personnel inside the circuit during the 13-hour period from 22:30 on 25 November to 11:30 on 26 November, 42 to 29 hours before P1; this was Alpine's second of six individual exceptions permitted in 2026 and the report says no action should be taken. Added this as a no-action note to Schedule, Notes and Penalties, not as a driver sanction. On 27 November, after the official index published Docs 11 and 12, visually reviewed FIA Entry List Doc 11 page 2 (SHA-256 1d4e6216e81a1a0ff79befabf269f2ecfd581aa3caa3d2b9033fe6e5bb1d5c2b): it names 20 race entrants and separately lists Jak Crawford as eligible for FP1 under regulations B1.7.3/B1.7.4. Cross-checked Aston Martin's official confirmation that he will drive Fernando Alonso's car; updated Rookies and Schedule to keep his FP1 appearance distinct from the race entry. Visually reviewed all substantive pages 2–13 of FIA Car Presentation Submissions Doc 12 (SHA-256 259a83f98d072bc8f865f9ff60f2f5ff9b683fcb63007dfc63099414c7f26c4b), including the Audi component diagram on page 11. All 11 teams are represented: Audi declares one Front Corner update, a revised lower front brake-duct deflector, with the filed reason Performance - Flow Conditioning; its description says the change improves flow-field quality. The other ten teams explicitly filed no updates. Added the complete team-by-team transcription and page-bound source readers to Upgrades, and summarized the finding on Overview, Teams and Notes. Exact source hashes are recorded below. On 27 November, visually reviewed the newly published FIA Document 13 Pirelli Preview V2 / Issue B (substantive page 2) and Race Director Document 14 V2 (substantive pages 2-7), then compared their substantive content with the earlier versions. Document 13 retains the pressure and compound table and clarifies the 27-lap count; Document 14 page 7 clarifies lap counting and safe replacement when pit entry closure causes a set to exceed the cap. Updated Qatar Tyres and Notes with these interpretations and their page-specific PDF links; the exact V2 URLs and fia_media.json hashes are recorded in fia_sha256. The reviewed Document 14 V2 lapping and Turn 16 rules are also shown on the Circuit page, with the current V2 source links; the pre-FP2 maximum remains explicitly pending.
